requirement_text.ISS-0705: Global Ecto.Adapters.SQL.Sandbox.mode(:auto) leak in tenants_test.exs/identity_test.exs never restored to :manual, causing persistent test-DB pollution. Root cause: test/letflow/routers/tenants_test.exs (~line 391) and test/letflow/routers/identity_test.exs (~lines 1361-1381) each flip Ecto.Adapters.SQL.Sandbox.mode(Letflow.Repo, :auto) mid-test (to allow the test's own process and spawned/async work to share a connection outside the sandbox's normal per-test checkout), and never restore it to :manual afterward -- no matching on_exit callback, no restoring flip at the end of the test. Once flipped to :auto for the remainder of the test run, every subsequent test in the same mix test invocation (and, per ISS-0704's own reproduction, across separate invocations against the same persistent dev/test database) inserts real, uncontained rows instead of rows scoped to a per-test sandboxed transaction that gets rolled back. ISS-0704's diagnosis confirmed 129+ such orphaned tenant rows had accumulated in the shared test DB. Fix should either (a) wrap the :auto mode flip in each affected test with a matching on_exit callback that restores :manual, or (b) restructure the tests so they no longer need the global mode flip (e.g. using Ecto.Adapters.SQL.Sandbox.allow/3 to share the sandboxed connection with a spawned process instead of disabling the sandbox outright) -- evaluate which fits each test's actual concurrency need. Operational note: the 129+ tenant rows already orphaned in the shared test DB by this leak should be identified and cleaned up as part of or alongside whatever run fixes this.
